),
distribution_requirement AS (
    SELECT
        gec.min_credits,
        gec.min_areas,
        gec.per_area_min_credits
    FROM general_education_requirements ger
    JOIN general_education_requirement_categories gec
      ON gec.general_requirement_id = ger.general_requirement_id
    JOIN general_education_category_members gcm

)

    END AS 영역_조건_충족
FROM input i
